title: Remark
body_md: \textnormal{One can also attempt to define a positive half-twist presentation extending the Artin presentation of the braid group. However, this quickly fails. The presentation would define an infinite rank Artin group. Such a group is infinitely generated and therefore cannot be the braid group.}
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md:
Suppose $R=B_n \cdot R_0$ for some finite set $R_0$ of relations. Let $\al_1,\dotsc,\al_m$ be the arcs whose positive half-twists appear in $R_0$. There is a maximum $N$ of the geometric intersection number of any pair $\al_i$ and $\al_j$.
    
    Choose arcs $\beta_1,\dotsc,\beta_k$ with pairwise geometric intersection numbers all larger than $N$. Then no relation can be used to relate $\tau_{\beta_1}\dots \tau_{\beta_k}$ to an equivalent word, so it is unique in its word equivalence class.
